title: Add tax to ledger entries and stop re-posting synced invoices
body:
The ledger now wants the tax amount on every entry, so the sync asks the tax service for a quote first.

The sync also used to post every invoice finalized in the window on every run and relied on the ledger deduplicating by `externalId`, which it stopped doing last week. Each invoice now gets `syncedAt` once it is posted and later runs skip it. Failed invoices stay unsynced and are picked up again by the next run.
